q: What does a virtual environment provide?
why: Virtual environments isolate dependencies from system Python and other projects.

q: Which command installs NumPy into the active interpreter's environment?
why: Using python -m pip ties pip to the selected interpreter.

q: Why avoid global pip installs on Arch Linux?
options: System Python packages are managed by the distribution
why: Use venv for project dependencies to avoid conflicting with pacman-managed Python.

q: What should be done before sharing a notebook?
options: Restart kernel and run all cells top-to-bottom
why: This checks that outputs do not depend on hidden execution state.
